# Third-party code

| Folder | What | From | License | Changes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `fm6/fm6_core.c` | msfa, the 6-operator DX7-compatible FM core of Dexed (Google, Pascal Gauthier), in Felucca's integer C port | [Felucca](https://github.com/hugelton/Felucca) `firmware/src/fm6_core.c`, commit `5d9694d` (2026-10-28) | Apache-2.0 (`fm6/LICENSE`, and the file's header) | Marked in the file's header: the operator loops scale the sine in float, and the other 64-bit multiplies are out of line, for the FM-1's CPU fault (felucca-bsp `docs/CPU.md`); the note's log frequency is multiplied in 32 bits. |
| `fm6/fm6_tables.h` | msfa's start-up tables, precomputed | generated by `tools/gen_fm6_tables.py` (msfa's formulas; checked equal to Felucca's) | Apache-2.0 data | – |

fm1-base (MPL-2.0) and felucca-bsp (MPL-2.0) come in as the `fm1-base` git submodule, each with its own licences and notices. The JieLi AC79 SDK files the firmware package uses (Apache-2.0) are fetched at build time, never committed.
